title: CODEOWNERS names a username, not an unresolvable team
context: GitHub requests reviews from CODEOWNERS, but only if the owner is resolvable. A team that does not exist matches nobody without warning or error.
decision: CODEOWNERS file names `@braden-seaborn` (a real username) rather than `@Firelight-Innovations/maintainers` (a team that does not exist). A username cannot be wrong in that way; swap it back to a team when one exists and has members.
consequences: The file looks less tidy with a username, but a tidier-looking unresolvable owner beats a real owner that silently does nothing. Until CODEOWNERS review is required (it is not as of 2026-08-21), this rule just prevents silent failure if/when branch protection is enabled.
